lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five primary horizontal rows and twelve visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a coordinate-like grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized lattice structure where luminance maxima are positioned at the grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins, running parallel to the horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple low-luminance, elongated fusiform shapes (biological hitchhikers) observed trailing the ventral pectoral region and proximal to the dorsal fin base.
